detail: Every store keeps at least the minimum display quantity per category for its tier (table below). A store giving stock away must not drop below it.
S++ stores never give away stock of their top-20 styles (sheet flagship_protected).
Do not send a store more stock than its stock_capacity_units (stores sheet).
Stock already in transit counts as arriving. Do not send it again.
No store-to-store transfer if the giving store would drop below 30 days of cover for that style.
Any single recommended move worth more than Rs 1,00,000 at MRP needs a human approval before it goes.
Today the company tops stores up from the warehouse every Monday. Your system can recommend any day.
Ignore transport cost. Lead time still matters (table below).
